Players Committee card image of [[Blue Squadron 1]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “May add 1 pilot. Snap deploys free aboard. While Snap piloting, immune to attrition < 5 and, once per turn, may use 1 Force to cancel a Force drain at another system within 1 parsec of Snap.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/bluesquadron1.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/bluesquadron1.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
